concerns.text: The validation step lists required columns (`subject_id`, `age`, `sex`, `fd_mean`) but does not explicitly require the `fc_upper_tri` column, which is mandatory according to `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`. This creates a mismatch between the plan and the data‑model/schema.

The plan states that `analysis_results.csv` will be written conforming to `contracts/output.schema.yaml`, yet it does not describe how the required `power_achieved` field (per‑metric power) will be populated. The current description only mentions a separate `power_report.txt`. This omission may cause the output to violate the contract.
